methods.population: Counted mature primary episodes. provenance_missing is excluded. pending_fill is excluded. The thickness gate's per-week cap is not applied.
methods.bootstrap: Block bootstrap of whole ISO entry weeks, 10000 resamples, random.Random seed 20261105 (the signature date; the seal does not name a seed). Each resample draws as many weeks as the counted set has, with replacement, and keeps every matched excess in a drawn week. The 90% interval is the linear 5th and 95th percentiles of those medians. The bar passes only when the lower end is above zero.
methods.fx: Each rate's date is the marker as_of, not the snapshot file name and not a live spot. The converter uses the latest as_of on or before the episode date. fetch_fx_rates is not called.
methods.same_dates: The reference slot book and the matched basket are both strategy_book_observe._slot_book on the same counted episodes, the same fill sessions and the same exit sessions. The slot book earns each episode's fair_cost_return after conversion into sterling. The basket earns that episode's basket_gross (equal-weight buy-tier price return from fill to exit) converted with the same two rates. Net asset value is marked on the union of those fill and exit dates. Total return is end net asset value minus 1, from a start of 1.0 in cash. The peak-to-trough fall is the absolute value of max_drawdown (nav/peak - 1 on those event dates, with each open position marked at its full holding return from the fill). The reference order is fill date then ticker. The 15 random orders inside _slot_book are not part of either bar.
methods.archive: archive_replay_report_only is the buy-tier-only arm of the committed archive replay. It is survivorship-biased and is not the proof.
